 Narsingi Apartment Fire At Pacifica Hillcrest 
 Hyderabad, Nov. 19: A fire broke   out at Pacifica Hillcrest Apartment in Narsingi, Rangareddy district , on Thursday, triggering panic among residents. 
 Panic gripped residents of Pacifica Hillcrest Apartments in Narsingi on Thursday after a sudden fire broke out and engulfed part of a residential block.
 #Hyderabad #Narsingi #FireAccident #PacificaHillcrest #TelanganaFireServices #CyberabadPolice #Telangana #IndToday #BREAKING https://t.co/dHQx82CR3U
 — indtoday (@ind2day) November 19, 2026 
 The fire erupted suddenly in one of the apartment blocks. After receiving information, firefighters rushed to the spot and began efforts to bring the blaze under control.
 Here To Join Us On WhatsApp 
 Fire Incident in Narsingi Under Investigation 
 The cause of the fire and the extent of property damage are yet to be determined. Details about possible injuries have also not been confirmed.
 Narsingi Apartment Fire At Pacifica Hillcrest Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.
